# Lexicon: the words your dictation keeps getting wrong

The full text of the site's model-facing documentation is generated from this
repository at build time and served at:

- <https://lexicon.ashlr.ai/llms-full.txt> - the maintained copy. Fetch that.

## What is here instead

This file exists so a checkout is not a dead end. The same content, kept in
sync by hand:

- [README.md](README.md): what it is, the demo, install, measured results.
- [docs/AGENTS.md](docs/AGENTS.md): the install-and-verify checklist for agents.
- [docs/MCP.md](docs/MCP.md): every MCP tool, resource and prompt.
- [docs/EXPORTS.md](docs/EXPORTS.md): the export formats and importers.
- [docs/BENCHMARK.md](docs/BENCHMARK.md): the measurements and the method.
- [SECURITY.md](SECURITY.md): what is local and how project files are gated.
- [docs/CLIENTS.md](docs/CLIENTS.md): per-client install detail.
- [docs/CLI.md](docs/CLI.md): the full command reference.
- [docs/FAQ.md](docs/FAQ.md): the frequently asked questions.

## Endpoints on the site

- <https://lexicon.ashlr.ai/llms.txt>: the index.
- <https://lexicon.ashlr.ai/llms-full.txt>: everything in one fetch.
- <https://lexicon.ashlr.ai/mcp.json>: the MCP install manifest.
- <https://lexicon.ashlr.ai/capabilities.json>: capabilities as JSON.
- <https://lexicon.ashlr.ai/server.json>: the MCP registry manifest.
- <https://lexicon.ashlr.ai/install>: the install and capabilities page.
